pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: tests/harness/test_cli_harness.py:9 The CLI transcripts this suite replays are hand-written (tests/fixtures/README.md:14 says all three are synthetic), carry no service version or capture date, and the only live lane is a provider test marked 'never run in CI', so a change in the upstream CLI format can never turn this suite red, which is the opposite of what the docstring claims.

techniques.evidence: tests/harness/test_cli_harness.py:9 The fixtures are a hand-written fake presented as a drift detector. No contract revision is recorded and no live lane runs on a schedule (pyproject marker: 'never run in CI'). The seam itself is good: a Transport protocol in production code, with ScriptedTransport replaying through it.

tests/harness/test_rounds_failures.py:325 The turn-wall cutoff is checked against total wall time. The _SlowRounds test also depends on two 0.4 s sleeps fitting inside a 1 s wall. Both turn red on a loaded runner with no defect present.

tests/harness/test_tokenfactory.py:618 The live, money-spending test sits in the same file and configuration as the offline unit tests. It is kept out by a marker plus a runtest_setup skip, which is membership by annotation, not by location.
tests/harness/test_tokenfactory.py:715 The marker-driven selection is measured by running pytest itself over an inner tree and asserting the passed, skipped and deselected counts, not reasoned about.

tests/harness/conftest.py:52 An API key in the developer's environment never decides that a test reaches a provider. Separately, test_engines and test_cli_harness assert that spawned children are stripped of API keys.
tests/harness/conftest.py:5 The fixtures are cheap in-memory fakes, and their honesty is held by a test that drives the real core classes through the same ports, so the fakes cannot drift.
tests/harness/test_policy.py:442 The tests assert which rule produced the refusal, not just that a refusal happened. A recording proxy (_Reads) also measures which inputs each rule actually read.

pairs.registryProposal: recorded-interaction-fixtures could name a distinct failure: a fixture honestly labelled synthetic in its own header, while the suite's docstring and ADR still claim that fixture turns upstream format drift into a red test. The honesty of the label does not reach the claim, and a hand-written fixture cannot detect drift at all.
